const query = `INSERT INTO calls.callback_on_missed_call (service_id, report_date, avg_gap_seconds, callback_count)
SELECT
  service_id, call_date,
  ROUND(AVG(gap_seconds)) AS avg_gap_seconds,
  COUNT(*) AS callback_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    missed.service_id,
    missed.call_date,
    (
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN ps.days_pattern <> 'All days' AND DAYOFWEEK(seq.day_date) = 1 THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST(0,
            TIME_TO_SEC(LEAST(GREATEST(
              IF(seq.day_date = DATE(next_event.start_time), TIME(next_event.start_time), ps.logout_time),
              ps.login_time), ps.logout_time))
            -
            TIME_TO_SEC(LEAST(GREATEST(
              IF(seq.day_date = DATE(missed.start_time), TIME(missed.start_time), ps.login_time),
              ps.login_time), ps.logout_time))
          )
        END
      ), 0)
      FROM (
        SELECT DATE(missed.start_time) + INTERVAL n DAY AS day_date
        FROM (SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4
              UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
              UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13) nums
        WHERE n <= DATEDIFF(DATE(next_event.start_time), DATE(missed.start_time))
      ) seq
    ) AS gap_seconds
  FROM calls.call_disposition missed
  JOIN calls.process_shift_schedule ps ON ps.service_id = missed.service_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cd2.call_type, cd2.start_time
    FROM calls.call_disposition cd2
    WHERE cd2.service_id = missed.service_id
      AND cd2.customer = missed.customer
      AND cd2.start_time > missed.start_time
      AND (cd2.call_type = 'OUTBOUND' OR (cd2.call_type = 'INBOUND' AND cd2.disposition = 'Answer'))
    ORDER BY cd2.start_time ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) next_event ON TRUE
  WHERE missed.call_type = 'INBOUND'
    AND (missed.service_id <> 1287 OR missed.ivr = 'Appointement/Other')
    AND missed.disposition != 'Answer'
    AND next_event.call_type = 'OUTBOUND'
    AND missed.call_date = '${d}'
    AND TIME(missed.start_time) BETWEEN ps.login_time AND ps.logout_time
    AND (ps.days_pattern = 'All days' OR DAYOFWEEK(missed.start_time) <> 1)
) callback_matches
GROUP BY service_id, call_date
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  avg_gap_seconds = VALUES(avg_gap_seconds),
  callback_count = VALUES(callback_count);`;
return [{ json: { query } }];

const query = `INSERT INTO calls.combined_summary (
  report_date, agent, sip, process_name, agent_mapped,
  inbound_answer, outbound_all, ob_answer, customer_missed, agent_missed_ob,
  apt, ib_tt, ob_tt
)
SELECT

  SEC_TO_TIME(ds.apt_sec), SEC_TO_TIME(ds.ib_tt_sec), SEC_TO_TIME(ds.ob_tt_sec)
FROM calls.daywise_summary ds
JOIN calls.dim_process dp ON dp.service_id = ds.service_id
WHERE ds.report_date = '${d}'
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  agent=VALUES(agent), process_name=VALUES(process_name), agent_mapped=VALUES(agent_mapped),
  inbound_answer=VALUES(inbound_answer), outbound_all=VALUES(outbound_all), ob_answer=VALUES(ob_answer),
  customer_missed=VALUES(customer_missed), agent_missed_ob=VALUES(agent_missed_ob),
  apt=VALUES(apt), ib_tt=VALUES(ib_tt), ob_tt=VALUES(ob_tt);`;

const query = `UPDATE calls.combined_summary cs
JOIN calls.dim_process dp ON dp.process_name = cs.process_name
JOIN (
  SELECT
    cd.service_id, cd.agent_number AS sip, cd.call_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.call_type='INBOUND' AND cd.disposition='Answer' AND (cd.service_id <> 1287 OR cd.ivr = 'Appointement/Other') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inbound_answered,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.call_type='OUTBOUND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_dialed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.call_type='OUTBOUND' AND cd.disposition='Answer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_answered,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.call_type='OUTBOUND' AND cd.disposition='No Answer' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outbound_no_answer
  FROM calls.call_disposition cd
  WHERE cd.call_date = '${d}'
  GROUP BY cd.service_id, cd.agent_number, cd.call_date
) x ON x.service_id = dp.service_id AND x.sip = cs.sip AND x.call_date = cs.report_date
SET cs.inbound_answer = x.inbound_answered,
    cs.outbound_all = x.outbound_dialed,
    cs.ob_answer = x.outbound_answered,
    cs.customer_missed = x.outbound_no_answer
WHERE cs.report_date = '${d}';`;
return [{ json: { query } }];

const query = `UPDATE calls.combined_summary cs
JOIN calls.dim_process dp ON dp.process_name = cs.process_name
JOIN (
  SELECT service_id, sip, event_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN status='Login' THEN period_start END) AS login_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN status='Logout' THEN period_start END) AS logout_time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Short Break','Meal','Bio-Break') THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS break_seconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Training' THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS training_seconds
  FROM calls.login_events
  WHERE event_date = '${d}'
  GROUP BY service_id, sip, event_date
) lc ON lc.service_id = dp.service_id AND lc.sip = cs.sip AND lc.event_date = cs.report_date
SET cs.login_time = lc.login_time,
    cs.login_out = lc.logout_time,
    cs.break_time = SEC_TO_TIME(lc.break_seconds),
    cs.hours = TIMEDIFF(lc.logout_time, lc.login_time),
    cs.training_time = SEC_TO_TIME(lc.training_seconds)
WHERE cs.report_date = '${d}';`;
return [{ json: { query } }];

const query = `UPDATE calls.combined_summary cs
JOIN calls.dim_process dp ON dp.process_name = cs.process_name
JOIN (
  SELECT service_id,
    CASE
      WHEN service_id = 1702 AND agent_name IN ('Admin','Sagarika') THEN 'Sagarika Bose'
      WHEN service_id = 1702 AND agent_name = 'Gulshan' THEN 'Gulshan Khan'
      WHEN service_id = 1702 AND agent_name = 'Avijit' THEN 'Avijit Dey'
      ELSE agent_name
    END AS agent_name, report_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Appreciation' AND (final_status IS NULL OR final_status <> 'No') THEN COALESCE(count,1) ELSE 0 END) AS appreciation_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Escalation' THEN COALESCE(count,1) ELSE 0 END) AS escalation_total
  FROM calls.activity_tracker
  WHERE report_date = '${d}'
  GROUP BY service_id, agent_name, report_date
) at ON at.service_id = dp.service_id AND LOWER(TRIM(at.agent_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(cs.agent)) AND at.report_date = cs.report_date

const query = `UPDATE calls.combined_summary cs
JOIN calls.dim_process dp ON dp.process_name = cs.process_name
LEFT JOIN calls.email_tagged_daily et
  ON et.service_id = dp.service_id
  AND et.report_date = cs.report_date
  -- ResMed's Sagarika Bose is logged as 'Admin' in combined_summary but as her
  -- real name in email_tagged_daily -- map that one identity so the join finds her.
  AND (CASE WHEN dp.service_id = 1702 AND et.agent_name = 'Sagarika' THEN 'Sagarika Bose'
       WHEN dp.service_id = 1702 AND et.agent_name = 'Gulshan' THEN 'Gulshan Khan'
       WHEN dp.service_id = 1702 AND et.agent_name = 'Avijit' THEN 'Avijit Dey'
       ELSE et.agent_name END)
     = (CASE WHEN dp.service_id = 1702 AND cs.agent = 'Admin' THEN 'Sagarika Bose' ELSE cs.agent END)
SET cs.email_sent = COALESCE(et.email_count, 0),
    cs.email_duration = SEC_TO_TIME(COALESCE(et.email_count, 0) * 180)
WHERE dp.service_id IN (489, 1702, 741, 295, 338) AND cs.report_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);`;
return [{ json: { query } }];

const query = `UPDATE calls.combined_summary cs

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT cd.service_id, cd.agent_number AS sip, cd.call_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.call_type='INBOUND' AND cd.ring_start_time IS NOT NULL AND cd.start_time IS NOT NULL AND (cd.service_id <> 1287 OR cd.ivr = 'Appointement/Other')
         THEN GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, cd.ring_start_time, cd.start_time)) ELSE 0 END) AS pick_time_sum_ib_sec,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.call_type='INBOUND' AND cd.ring_start_time IS NOT NULL AND cd.start_time IS NOT NULL AND (cd.service_id <> 1287 OR cd.ivr = 'Appointement/Other')
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pick_time_count_ib,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.call_type='OUTBOUND' AND cd.ring_start_time IS NOT NULL AND cd.start_time IS NOT NULL
         THEN GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, cd.ring_start_time, cd.start_time)) ELSE 0 END) AS pick_time_sum_ob_sec,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.call_type='OUTBOUND' AND cd.ring_start_time IS NOT NULL AND cd.start_time IS NOT NULL
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pick_time_count_ob
  FROM calls.call_disposition cd
  JOIN calls.daywise_summary ds
    ON ds.service_id = cd.service_id AND ds.agent_sip = cd.agent_number AND ds.report_date = cd.call_date
  WHERE cd.disposition = 'Answer' AND cd.call_date = '${d}'
    AND ds.agent_name NOT REGEXP '^t[ra][ra]ns'
    AND ds.agent_name NOT LIKE '%\_%'
    AND ds.agent_name NOT LIKE '%(%'
    AND ds.agent_name NOT IN (
      'Emergency','Insurance','Ambulance','Reception',
      'Hospital lines','Hospital Lines','PSRI team','PSRI Team','Team',
      'Testing','Test','Testin','POSTMAN_TEST',
      'A Block OPD Extension ground floor','Corporate desk','Dialysis Billing',
      'Echo Lab','Harshita PHC Lab','TPA Dispatch Extension'
    )
  GROUP BY cd.service_id, cd.agent_number, cd.call_date
) pt ON pt.service_id = dp.service_id AND pt.sip = cs.sip AND pt.call_date = cs.report_date
SET cs.pick_time_sum_ib_sec = pt.pick_time_sum_ib_sec,
    cs.pick_time_count_ib = pt.pick_time_count_ib,
    cs.pick_time_sum_ob_sec = pt.pick_time_sum_ob_sec,
    cs.pick_time_count_ob = pt.pick_time_count_ob
WHERE cs.report_date = '${d}';`;
